ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 70% high-intensity (white) pixels in the interior regions and 30% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels along the perimeter and within surface markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central areas of both lobes. These are surrounded by a thick, low-intensity dark border at the trailing edge and a dark vertical band at the median notch. Extensive low-intensity linear streaks and mottled patterns are mapped across the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow U-shaped central depression with a calculated obtuse angle estimated at 160 degrees; bounding-box depth is low relative to the overall lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with high-frequency peaks and valleys ranging from 2 to 12 pixels in amplitude, isolated against the lighter background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the upper boundary of both lobes, tapering toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups located at the distal tip of the right lobe; additional isolated white spots are visible on the dark central pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of parallel and intersecting dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity white surfaces on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across the visible ventral area; white calcified-looking clusters on the rightmost distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive dark vertical band where the two fluke lobes converge at the median notch.
